user.title: Add an OOLY controller
user.description: Enter the controller's IP address or hostname. Reserve a static IP on your router (DHCP reservation) so it does not change.

pick_type.title: OOLY controller type
pick_type.description: Choose how this controller is used. This is your choice, not the device's wiring — a 5-channel controller can still be used as tunable white only. You can change it later via Reconfigure.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Add an OOLY controller
zeroconf_confirm.description: Discovered "{name}" at {host}. Choose the controller type and add it.

reconfigure.title: OOLY controller settings
reconfigure.description: Change the controller type and how often Home Assistant polls it for external changes.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the controller. Check the IP/hostname and that the device is online.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the discovered controller.
